label.explanation: index-worker crashes with an unhandled exception every time it processes msg-195727 at offset 246773, and on each restart resumes at that same committed offset (lines 166, 172, 175, 182, 183, 194). The restarts (lines 167, 171, 176, 181, 184, 191) run the same version v4.5.8 — not a deploy — and the lag (lines 205, 216, 240, 264, 288, 304, 336) is the consequence. Skip/dead-letter offset 246773 and harden the handler. Red herrings: line 32 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out).
